name: Misty Scarlet Daze
source:
Claire Clawthorne, a shut-in crybaby wolf who closes herself off after an incident with her mother, becomes obsessed with the beautiful Scarlett Haze, a cute girl with just about 20 screws loose.

 Her obsession soon leads her to break into the girl's house who...oddly enough...doesn't apprehend or condemn her but rather...*encourages* her behavior?! 

What is wrong with her! And why would you break into a cute girl's house anyways!? What a pair of oddballs! Wouldn't you say so, dear friend?

[From [url=https://shinitai-tan.itch.io/misty-scarlet-daze]itch.io[/url]]
